decision.message: Selected 'fast' profile for 400 kHz I2C bus with usual family operating limits. Limits are not measurements but family specifications.

clauses.text: For my BMP280 controller I need a 400 kHz I2C bus,
clauses.reason: Request specifies 400 kHz I2C bus, matching 'fast' profile of the family.

clauses.text: with the usual family operating limits.
clauses.reason: Request uses usual family operating limits, corresponding to published supply and ambient conditions.
